notes: PLG inbound — solo founder building 'MuseChat' (writer-facing assistant). Signed up self-serve, no AE touch. Wants low-friction hosted API: easy SDK, streaming, function/tool-calling. Primary flows: interactive chat for writers (latency-sensitive), per-user doc embeddings for search/similarity, and a small code-assistant helper for formatting snippets. Early feedback: "love the simple SDK, shipping fast" but called out token costs on long-context drafts. No enterprise compliance required yet; founder said "we store only public/opted-in uploads, retention minimal". Key asks from testing: visible token/cost breakdown per request, quick region choice (NA), clear burst/rate-limit doc, and sample configs for 1) low-latency chat and 2) cheap background embedding jobs. POC status: working prototype, ~200 MAU on prototype site, expect ~2-3x in 6–8 weeks if UX stays sticky. Quote from founder: "If we can keep per-article inference cost < $0.05 we can afford to scale." Suggested next action: automated email nudges + invite to community, do not escalate to AE unless spend or complexity increases.
